description: This file contains C# source code defining UI components and converters for the SupplementaryResults view in a Calculator application, including data templates, style converters, and a custom UserControl.

classes.name: DelighterUnitToStyleConverter
classes.description: Converts a Unit object to a Style based on its whimsical property.

classes.name: SupplementaryResultDataTemplateSelector
classes.description: Selects between different DataTemplates for SupplementaryResult items based on whether they are whimsical.

classes.name: SupplementaryResultNoOverflowStackPanel
classes.description: Custom StackPanel that prioritizes the last item if it is whimsical.

classes.name: SupplementaryResults
classes.description: UserControl that displays a collection of SupplementaryResult objects with data binding.

methods.name: DelighterUnitToStyleConverter()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resource dictionary for styles.

methods.name: Convert()
methods.description: Converts a Unit object to a Style if it is whimsical.

methods.name: SelectTemplateCore()
methods.description: Selects the appropriate DataTemplate based on whether the SupplementaryResult is whimsical.

methods.name: ShouldPrioritizeLastItem()
methods.description: Determines if the last child should be prioritized based on its whimsical property.

methods.name: Results getter/setter
methods.description: Property for binding the collection of SupplementaryResult objects.
